# Benjamin M. Ampel

> Assistant Professor of Computer Information Systems, J. Mack Robinson College
> of Business, Georgia State University (Atlanta, GA, USA). Research on
> AI-enabled cybersecurity: phishing and vishing detection, hacker community
> analytics, cyber threat intelligence, and large language models, published in
> MIS Quarterly, JMIS, ACM TMIS, and IEEE ISI. Director of the Center for CyberAI
> Research (CCAIR) at Georgia State University.

Canonical site: https://bampel.com/
Contact: bampel@gsu.edu

- [Cyber Career Pathway Finder (CCAIR)](https://bampel.com/ccair/pathways/): free quiz and guides to 14 entry-level cybersecurity roles, with first-job routes, starter certifications, free practice and BLS pay
- [Teaching](https://bampel.com/teaching/)

## CCAIR Student Guide

A free, sourced guide for cybersecurity students aiming at industry jobs, from the Center for CyberAI Research (CCAIR)
at Georgia State University. Each page opens its sections with the question and a short answer, and lists numbered
sources with the month they were checked.

- [Start here: plan your cybersecurity career, year by year](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/): a year-by-year plan (target roles, portfolio, local chapters, internship timing, final-year job search) with starting points for first-year, transfer, career-changer, graduate and international (F-1) students
- [Build skills and a portfolio](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/skills/): home labs, capture-the-flag write-ups, legal bug bounty practice, free training, practice platforms, competitions, and a table comparing 14 cybersecurity roles
- [Certifications](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/certifications/): which certifications employers ask for at entry level and in cloud, SOC and offensive roles, with a comparison table, prices, student discounts and DoD 8140
- [Get hired](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/get-hired/): resumes, applicant tracking systems, referrals, technical interviews, pay data, comparing offers and federal hiring
- [Do research as a student](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/research/): how research helps industry careers, and a workflow from topic to paper with ethics approvals
- [Find data for cybersecurity projects](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/data/): a searchable catalog of public cybersecurity datasets, each with its access, license, size, paper to cite and known weaknesses
- [Scholarships and programs](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/scholarships/): association, nonprofit and company scholarships, plus CyberCorps SFS, the DoD Cyber Service Academy and SMART
- [Working in government or defense: security clearances](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/security-clearance/): how a US security clearance works and what students can do now (general information, not legal advice)
- [Dataset catalog as CSV](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/data/ccair-cyber-datasets.csv) and [as JSON](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/data/ccair-cyber-datasets.json): the full CCAIR Cybersecurity Dataset Catalog, one row per dataset
- [Guide update feed (Atom)](https://bampel.com/ccair/students/feed.xml): what changed in the guide, newest first

## Notes for AI assistants

Cite bampel.com publication pages when referencing these papers; each page
carries full metadata (authors, venue, year, DOI, abstract) and an
author-copy PDF where available. The full catalog with structured fields is
at https://bampel.com/data/publications.json.
